```{r}
# 2. Function for QC + scDblFinder (applied to each sample)
process_sample <- function(obj) {
  # Mitochondrial percentage
  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  
  # QC filtering
  obj <- subset(obj, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                              nFeature_RNA < 5000 & 
                              percent.mt < 15)
  
  # ----- scDblFinder -----
  sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(obj)
  sce <- scDblFinder(sce)
  
  obj$doublet_score <- sce$scDblFinder.score
  obj$doublet_class <- sce$scDblFinder.class
  
  # Keep only singlets
  obj <- subset(obj, subset = doublet_class == "singlet")
  
  message(obj$sample_id[1], ": ", ncol(obj), " cells remaining after doublet removal")
  
  return(obj)
}

# Apply to all samples
#obj1 <- process_sample(obj1)
obj2 <- process_sample(obj2)
#obj3 <- process_sample(obj3)

# 3. Create a named list and merge
sample_list <- list(S2  = obj2,S4  = obj4,S6  = obj6,S8  = obj8,S10 = obj10,S12 = obj12)
# Merge using the named list (Seurat automatically uses list names for cell prefixes)
combined <- merge(x = sample_list[[1]], y = sample_list[-1], add.cell.ids = names(sample_list))

combined <- JoinLayers(combined)
# Verify cell counts per sample
table(combined$sample_id)
```

```{r}
# 4. Normalization + Clustering
combined <- NormalizeData(combined)
combined <- FindVariableFeatures(combined, nfeatures = 3000)
combined <- ScaleData(combined)
combined <- RunPCA(combined, npcs = 50)
ElbowPlot(combined, ndims = 50)
combined <- FindNeighbors(combined, dims = 1:30)
combined <- FindClusters(combined, resolution = 0.5)
combined <- RunUMAP(combined, dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "unintegrated_UMAP")
```


```{r}
# Quick look
DimPlot(combined, reduction = "unintegrated_UMAP", group.by = "sample_id")
DimPlot(combined, reduction = "unintegrated_UMAP", label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
combined[["RNA"]] <- split(combined[["RNA"]], f = combined$sample_id)
combined <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = combined,
  method = RPCAIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca",
  new.reduction = "integrated.rpca",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  verbose = TRUE)
combined <- FindNeighbors(combined, reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:30)
combined <- FindClusters(combined, resolution = 0.5)
combined <- RunUMAP(combined, reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:30,
                    reduction.name = "integrated_UMAP")
```


```{r}
# Compare before vs after integration
p1 <- DimPlot(combined, reduction = "unintegrated_UMAP", group.by = "sample_id") + ggtitle("Unintegrated")
p2 <- DimPlot(combined, reduction = "integrated_UMAP", group.by = "sample_id") + ggtitle("Integrated")
p1 + p2
DimPlot(combined, reduction = "integrated_UMAP", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE)
```
